title: Custom Middleware
description: Learn how to create your own middleware.

data.text: You can create custom middleware for application-specific logic like logging, timing, or request modification.

data.title: Custom Middleware
data.content: Creating request timing middleware with proper imports

data.title: Extension Methods
data.text: Create extension methods for cleaner registration: app.UseRequestTiming() instead of app.UseMiddleware<T>().

terms.definition: A delegate that represents the next middleware in the pipeline.
The method custom middleware must implement to process requests asynchronously.
The extension method that registers custom middleware in the pipeline.
A pattern where middleware dependencies are resolved from DI instead of constructor parameters.

data.title: Add a Logging Middleware
data.description: Create a custom middleware that logs the HTTP method and path for every incoming request.
steps: Create a LoggingMiddleware class with a constructor accepting RequestDelegate and ILogger
Implement InvokeAsync to log the request method and path before calling _next
Register the middleware in Program.cs before UseAuthorization
data.expectedOutcome: Every request logs a message like 'GET /api/values received' before reaching the controller.
